justification: Inspected javaparser-core-serialization/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/serialization/JavaParserJsonSerializer.java, javaparser-core-serialization/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/serialization/JavaParserJsonSerializerTest.java, and javaparser-core-serialization/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/serialization/JavaParserJsonDeserializer.java. The serializer is 201 lines and exposes one public API plus a private recursive helper and four small protected helpers, all centered on one concern: turning AST nodes into JSON. The nested enums only hold JSON key constants, and the test shows a single end-to-end serialization path. I did not find strong evidence of multiple separable responsibilities or excessive method/size complexity for this class.
